summary: 34 features and 10 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • agent-templates: scope template index by display locale (288f67d)
  • prompts: name the OMP ask tool in non-interactive declarations (b5397f4)
  • omp: ask interactive questions through rpc-ui (3de5e02)
  • interactive: add omp entry to agent CLI interactive control (595248d)
  • pi: route ask_user_question through the session question flow (8cb0864)
  • interactive: enable interactive question control for Pi CLI (2d6d4ae)
  • hero-dungeons: require fallback crew setup before adding heroes (3724897)
  • omniroute: add explicit model list refresh endpoint and service (d0caa46)

HagiCode-org/web

  • wizard: add theme picker and replace the language combobox (fac9b1c)
  • theme: override family grid columns and stop theme fallback (1155d46)
  • wizard: rebuild the initialization drawer around steps (b2bb40e)
  • wizard: add the project step with folder browse (917efdd)
  • wizard: add the Hagicoder setup step (1d4e766)
  • wizard: add persisted step state and readiness checks (08ea9ea)
  • project: add optional folder browse to the project form (76daf5f)
  • health: let agent CLI health checks be cancelled (e7ab5b8)
  • chat: open Read tool images in the lightbox (b37bfa6)
  • ui: add zoom controls to the image lightbox (9a505db)
  • hero: scope agent template catalogs to the display language (b9d2ea5)
  • chat: show tool call images in their own rows (49c298b)
  • ui: add image lightbox for tool result images (b55d401)
  • tool-result: extract every image from tool result payloads (e5f2ff3)
  • settings: support OMP in agent CLI interactive control (6b8c116)
  • status-bar: add token monitor milestone popover (6ca9639)
  • repo-select: remember recent repositories per task type (5361adf)
  • session: track waiting-for-reply origin stage (8580a5b)
  • status-bar: add salary workday progress edge (7b76b74)
  • status-bar: add token monitor level progress edge (ecab154)
  • hero: offer max thinking level for Pi equipment (bc4778f)
  • settings: support Pi in agent CLI interactive control (e906523)
  • status-bar: preview consumption tiers from token monitor details (7983a83)
  • hero: integrate emergency team into dungeon scenarios as fallback (163b21e)
  • omniroute: add manual model catalog refresh action (978dc89)
  • status-bar: add tiered visual motifs and details popover to token monitor (76b9acd)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claude: lift tool result images that only appear in content (86a1dc9)
  • prompts: declare one-shot prompts non-interactive (e08b9ae)
  • session: keep waiting-for-reply origin across resume and cancel (5b88b71)
  • session: read question messages from the session bucket (09cbf37)
  • cli: emit Pi and Omp thinking as thinking deltas (5aa7e34)
  • web: limit auto-compose commit prompt to commit-only work (1da881d)
  • pi: stream incremental deltas and report reasoning tokens (73c9b7b)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: save the draft when the detail drawer closes (110cc59)
  • chat: skip result summaries for image tool results (5971b27)
  • chat: preserve keyed segments when merging messages (49d0f0a)
